title: Industrial Multi-Function Energy Meter Pakistan 2026 — WAPDA/DISCO Tariff Optimisation, CT Ratio Selection, Modbus RTU/TCP, SCADA Integration | Complete Buyer Guide
summary_html: Complete buyer guide for industrial multi-function energy meters (MFMs) in Pakistan 2026. Covers WAPDA/DISCO tariff structure optimisation, CT ratio selection for industrial loads, Modbus RTU/TCP SCADA integration patterns, NEPRA billing dispute evidence requirements, IEC 62053 accuracy classes, TOU energy registers, and PKR prices from PKR 12,000 to PKR 380,000. Includes 7 Pakistan-specific installation pitfalls and a 10-point selection checklist for engineers and procurement officers.
